headword: {食物連鎖|しょくもつれんさ}

definitions.explanation: the hierarchy of organisms in an ecosystem, showing who eats whom, from producers to top predators

examples.japanese: {食物連鎖|しょくもつれんさ}の{頂点|ちょうてん}に{立|た}つ{動物|どうぶつ}。
examples.english: An animal at the top of the food chain.

examples.japanese: {食物連鎖|しょくもつれんさ}が{崩|くず}れると{生態系|せいたいけい}に{影響|えいきょう}が{出|で}る。
examples.english: When the food chain is disrupted, it affects the ecosystem.

examples.japanese: {海|うみ}の{食物連鎖|しょくもつれんさ}について{学|まな}ぶ。
examples.english: To learn about the food chain in the ocean.

notes:
{食物連鎖|しょくもつれんさ} is a biology term describing the hierarchy of organisms in an ecosystem based on feeding relationships.

COMPONENTS:
- {食物|しょくもつ} (food) + {連鎖|れんさ} (chain, linkage)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {食物連鎖|しょくもつれんさ}の{頂点|ちょうてん}: top of the food chain
- {食物連鎖|しょくもつれんさ}が{崩|くず}れる: the food chain collapses
- {食物連鎖|しょくもつれんさ}に{影響|えいきょう}を{与|あた}える: to affect the food chain

RELATED TERMS:
- {食物網|しょくもつもう}: food web (more complex, interconnected model)
- {生態系|せいたいけい}: ecosystem
- {捕食者|ほしょくしゃ}: predator
- {生産者|せいさんしゃ}: producer (plants)

REGISTER:
Used in scientific, educational, and environmental contexts. Common in school biology classes and environmental discussions.
